verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration and visa legal-services firm that offers case strategy, petition packaging and attorney support. Running such a service headlessly or in a CI pipeline is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an executable, CLI or automation runtime that would make the axis apply; the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
